defmodule SDKSnapshot do
  require Record

  Record.defrecordp(
    :span,
    Record.extract(:span, from: Path.join(:code.lib_dir(:opentelemetry, :include), "otel_span.hrl"))
  )

  Record.defrecordp(
    :event,
    Record.extract(:event, from: Path.join(:code.lib_dir(:opentelemetry, :include), "otel_span.hrl"))
  )

  Record.defrecordp(
    :link,
    Record.extract(:link, from: Path.join(:code.lib_dir(:opentelemetry, :include), "otel_span.hrl"))
  )

  Record.defrecordp(
    :scope,
    :instrumentation_scope,
    Record.extract(:instrumentation_scope,
      from: Path.join(:code.lib_dir(:opentelemetry_api, :include), "opentelemetry.hrl")
    )
  )

  Record.defrecordp(
    :status,
    Record.extract(:status, from: Path.join(:code.lib_dir(:opentelemetry_api, :include), "opentelemetry.hrl"))
  )

  def document(records, resource) do
    %{spans: Enum.map(records, &snapshot(&1, resource))}
  end

  defp snapshot(s, resource) do
    scope = span(s, :instrumentation_scope)
    status = span(s, :status)
    events = :otel_events.list(span(s, :events))
    links = :otel_links.list(span(s, :links))

    %{
      trace_id: hex(span(s, :trace_id), 128),
      span_id: hex(span(s, :span_id), 64),
      parent_id: hex(span(s, :parent_span_id), 64),
      parent_remote: span(s, :parent_span_is_remote),
      name: text(span(s, :name)),
      kind: Map.fetch!(%{internal: 1, server: 2, client: 3, producer: 4, consumer: 5}, span(s, :kind)),
      start: Integer.to_string(:opentelemetry.timestamp_to_nano(span(s, :start_time))),
      end: Integer.to_string(:opentelemetry.timestamp_to_nano(span(s, :end_time))),
      state: :otel_tracestate.encode_header(span(s, :tracestate)),
      flags: span(s, :trace_flags),
      attributes: attrs(span(s, :attributes)),
      resource: attrs(:otel_resource.attributes(resource)),
      resource_schema: text(:otel_resource.schema_url(resource)),
      scope: %{
        name: text(scope(scope, :name)),
        version: text(scope(scope, :version)),
        schema: text(scope(scope, :schema_url)),
        attributes: []
      },
      status: if(status == :undefined, do: 0, else: Map.fetch!(%{unset: 0, ok: 1, error: 2}, status(status, :code))),
      message: if(status == :undefined, do: "", else: text(status(status, :message))),
      dropped_attributes: :otel_attributes.dropped(span(s, :attributes)),
      dropped_events: :otel_events.dropped(span(s, :events)),
      dropped_links: :otel_links.dropped(span(s, :links)),
      events:
        Enum.map(events, fn e ->
          %{
            name: text(event(e, :name)),
            time: Integer.to_string(:opentelemetry.timestamp_to_nano(event(e, :system_time_native))),
            attributes: attrs(event(e, :attributes)),
            dropped: :otel_attributes.dropped(event(e, :attributes))
          }
        end),
      links:
        Enum.map(links, fn l ->
          %{
            trace_id: hex(link(l, :trace_id), 128),
            span_id: hex(link(l, :span_id), 64),
            state: :otel_tracestate.encode_header(link(l, :tracestate)),
            attributes: attrs(link(l, :attributes)),
            dropped: :otel_attributes.dropped(link(l, :attributes))
          }
        end)
    }
  end

  defp hex(:undefined, _), do: ""
  defp hex(id, bits), do: Base.encode16(<<id::size(bits)>>, case: :lower)
  defp text(:undefined), do: ""
  defp text(v) when is_binary(v), do: v
  defp text(v) when is_atom(v), do: Atom.to_string(v)
  defp text(v) when is_list(v), do: List.to_string(v)

  defp attrs(values),
    do: values |> :otel_attributes.map() |> Enum.map(fn {key, value} -> %{key: text(key), value: any(value)} end)

  defp any(v) when is_boolean(v), do: %{boolValue: v}
  defp any(v) when is_integer(v), do: %{intValue: Integer.to_string(v)}
  defp any(v) when is_float(v), do: %{doubleValue: v}
  defp any(v) when is_binary(v) or is_atom(v), do: %{stringValue: text(v)}
  defp any(v) when is_list(v), do: %{arrayValue: %{values: Enum.map(v, &any/1)}}
  defp any(v) when is_tuple(v), do: any(Tuple.to_list(v))
end
